answer: At first payout, a public quartz-beacon pulse selects one in twenty newcomers for a blind audit after answers are committed, so farms cannot choose the profiles checked. Three independent reviewers compare signed task histories; a confirmed duplicate freezes pending rewards and burns the proposed audit fee. This check is triggered on every new account’s first claim, across the submission tide. Proposed fee: 2.5 POA per identity; 2.5 × 1,000 = 2,500 POA for 1,000 fake identities versus 2.5 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: patient operators can still vary their behavior.
